  CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Mayor  www.SanMarinoCA.gov
Tony Chou, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Hunter Chang, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber

John Chou, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Calvin Lo, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108

Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  FRIDAY, FEBRUARY 28, 2025 AT 8:30 AM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626)
300-0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City
will do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:

  Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00
  p.m. the day before the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. will

  be distributed to City Council during the meeting. Any comments received after 3:00
  p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not provided to City Council
  at the meeting.
  Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us
  teleconference module during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted
  after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL

Council Member Chang, Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Vice Mayor Chou, and
Mayor Shepherd Romey

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to
place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

  NEW BUSINESS

 1.  REVIEW OF FISCAL YEAR 2024-25 MID-YEAR FINANCIAL REVIEW,
  UPDATED FIVE-YEAR FINANCIAL FORECAST AND LONG-TERM
  FINANCIAL  PROJECTIONS,  AND  APPROVAL  OF  BUDGET
  AMENDMENTS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that this report be received and filed, and that
  the Council approve the proposed FY 2024-25 budget adjustments as reflected in
  Attachments 1 and 2. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendations, the
  appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the FY 2024-25 Mid-Year Financial review, Updated Five-
  Year Financial Forecast, and Long-Term Financial Projections, and approve the FY
  2024-25 proposed budget amendments.”

AGENDA – FEBRUARY 28, 2025  PAGE 2 of 5
 REVISED

 2.  REAPPROPRIATION OF AQUATICS PROGRAM BUDGET

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council reappropriate the aquatics
  program budget and discontinue the program. If the City Council concurs, an
  appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to reappropriate the aquatics program budget and discontinue the program.”

 3.  APPROVAL OF AMENDMENT NO. 3 WITH ECONOMICS, INC. IN THE
  AMOUNT OF $198,910 FOR SOLID WASTE CONSULTING SERVICES
  AND AUTHORIZATION TO ISSUE A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP)
  FOR MUNICIPAL SOLID WASTE AND DIVERTIBLE MATERIALS
  COLLECTION, PROCESSING, DISPOSAL AND TRANSPORTATION
  SERVICES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve Amendment No. 3
  to the agreement with Economics, Inc. for solid waste consulting services and
  authorize staff to issue a RFP for solid waste and recycling services. If the Council
  concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to 1) approve Amendment No. 3 to the agreement with Economics, Inc. for
  solid waste consulting services in the amount of $198,910, 2) authorize the City
  Manager to execute the Amendment on behalf of the City, 3) approve a budget
  amendment for FY 2024-25 adding $90,000 to Account # 101-40-4104-0000 and 4)
  authorize staff to issue a Request for Proposals (RFP) for municipal solid waste and
  divertible materials collection, processing, disposal and transportation services.”

  CONSENT CALENDAR

 4.  APPROVAL OF AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO THE MAINTENANCE SERVICES
  AGREEMENT WITH MARIPOSA TREE MANAGEMENT FOR PROFESSIONAL
  TREE MAINTENANCE SERVICES IN THE AMOUNT OF $220,000 AND
  APPROVAL OF A BUDGET AMENDMENT

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve Amendment No. 1 with
  Mariposa Tree Management, increasing the total contract amount to $2,237,227 and
  authorize the City Manager to execute the Amendment. If Council concurs with staff’s
  recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve Amendment No. 1 with Mariposa Tree Management, increasing the
  total contract amount to $2,237,227 and authorize the City Manager to execute the
  Amendment.”

AGENDA – FEBRUARY 28, 2025  PAGE 3 of 5
 REVISED

 5.  APPROVAL OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH WESTERN
  AUDIO VISUAL FOR THE INSTALLATION AND 5 YEAR MAINTENANCE
  CONTRACT FOR AUDIO-VISUAL SYSTEM IMPROVEMENTS FOR CITY
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS AND INSTALLATION OF CAMERAS FOR PUBLIC
  MEETING RECORDING AT THE SAN MARINO COMMUNITY CENTER IN THE
  AMOUNT OF $110,139.11

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council award and approve the installation and
  5-year maintenance contract with WesternAV for audio-visual system improvements for
  City Council chambers and installation of cameras for public meeting recording at the
  San Marino Community Center. If the Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an
  appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve the Professional Services Agreement with Western Audio Visual for
  the installation and 5-year maintenance contract for audio-visual improvements for City
  Council chambers and installation of cameras for public meeting recording at the San
  Marino Community Center in the amount of $110,139.11.”

 6.  AWARD OF EMERGENCY MINOR CONSTRUCTION AGREEMENT TO
  SUPERIOR AWNING TO REPLACE WINDSTORM DAMAGED PUBLIC
  WORKS WASH BAY AWNING COVER IN THE AMOUNT OF $51,760

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve an award of an emergency
  minor construction agreement in the amount of $51,760 to Superior Awning for the
  removal of the damaged wash bay awning cover and installation of a new wash bay
  awning cover, and approve a budget adjustment in the amount of $51,760 in account
  #101-08-4376-2025. If the Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate
  motion would be:

  “I move to approve an award of an emergency minor construction agreement in the
  amount of $51,760 to Superior Awning for the removal of the damaged wash bay awning
  cover and installation of a new wash bay awning cover, approve the necessary budget
  adjustments, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the
  City.”

 7.  APPROVAL OF CONTRACT FOR CONSULTING ARBORIST SERVICES WITH
  PETER C. HARNISCH, CONSULTING ARBORIST

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve the contract and
  authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement. If the City Council concurs with
  staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve the contract with Peter Harnisch, Consulting Arborist and authorize
  the City Manager to execute the agreement.”

AGENDA – FEBRUARY 28, 2025  PAGE 4 of 5
 REVISED

 8.  APPROVAL OF CONTRACT AMENDMENT WITH RAFTELIS FINANCIAL
  CONSULTANTS, INC

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the contract amendment in the
  amount not-to-exceed $7,208. Staff also recommends the approval of budget
  adjustments needed in the General fund to cover the cost of the amendment. If Council
  agrees with staff’s recommendation a motion would be:

  “I move to authorize the City Manager to execute the contract amendment with Raftelis,
  in the amount not to exceed $7,208 and approve the FY 24/25 budget amendment to
  appropriate $7,208 in the General Fund.”

 9.  RECEIVE AND FILE FINANCIAL REPORT  FOR  SECOND  QUARTER
  (OCTOBER 2024 THROUGH DECEMBER 2024)

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that Council receive and file this report. If the City
  Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the financial report reflecting the City’s revenues and
  expenditures as of December 31, 2024.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

ADJOURNMENT

  CITY CLERK
